fields.climate: varies from tropical to near temperate
fields.terrain: mostly mountains and hills; some moderately sloping plains
fields.resources: asbestos, coal, clay, cassiterite, hydropower, forests, small gold and diamond deposits, quarry stone, and talc
fields.farm: sugarcane, maize, root vegetables, grapefruits, oranges, milk, pineapples, bananas, beef, sweet potatoes
fields.exports: scented mixtures, raw sugar, industrial acids/oils/alcohols, garments, wood
fields.industries: soft drink concentrates, coal, forestry, sugar processing, textiles, and apparel
fields.languages: English (official, used for government business), siSwati (official)
fields.religions: Christian 90% (Zionist - a blend of Christianity and traditional African religions - 40%, Roman Catholic 20%, other Christian 30% - includes Anglican, Methodist, Church of Jesus Christ, Jehovah's…
fields.legal: mixed system of civil, common, and customary law
fields.military: 18-35 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; no conscription
